say:1:1322547001:1.text: Our people spotted some cultists lurking around Valesa Castle. No idea what they're up to this time.
say:1:1322547001:1.source_cn: 我们的人在瓦勒沙城堡附近又发现了一些邪教徒，不知道他们...

say:2:1322547002:1.text: These people aren't scared of the guards, but they seem to fear anyone who knows magic.
say:2:1322547002:1.source_cn: 这些人似乎并不害怕侍卫，反而更加畏惧懂得神秘魔法力量的人。

say:3:1322547003:1.text: I hate to ask again, Magister, but we could really use your help with this one.
say:3:1322547003:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，这次又得麻烦您了。
